# ZERODIN

> ZERODIN is a cybersecurity company building tools for security operators, network engineers, and organizations protecting critical infrastructure.

ZERODIN ships two products today:

- **ATHELOS** — a cybersecurity command center for the solo operator. Five pillars: knowledge, engagements, delivery, business, tooling. Three deployment models: self-hosted, dedicated, cloud. Database-per-tenant Cloud with proven isolation.
- **OTA Sentinel** — a SIM security platform for telecom operators and regulators. Audits SIM cards for Simjacker vulnerabilities. Secure OTA management with KIC/KID keys. Three commercial tiers: Audit Report, Network License, Sovereign/MSSP.

More products are in development.
